description: The strings the LongText and LongIdentifier scenarios substitute in.

strings.long_text: A description long enough that a column which assumed a short value has to decide what it does about the rest of it, which is exactly the decision this scenario exists to make visible before a page ships.
strings.paragraph: Components read roles, never numbers. The profile decides the values, so the same component is near-flat graphite in NovuSpace and rounded emerald in NovuTrade with no conditional anywhere.
